1.

The present petition has been filed under Section 482 Cr.P.C. on behalf of the petitioners seeking quashing of FIR No.1722/2015, registered under Sections 498A/406/34 IPC at P.S. Mehrauli, Delhi on the ground that the Parties have amicably settled the dispute.
2. The Order Sheets indicate that other than three dates, there is no appearance on behalf of the Parties.
Today, also there is no appearance on behalf of the Parties.
3. In view of the above, the petition is dismissed for non-prosecution, along with pending application(s), if any.
SUBRAMONIUM PRASAD, J SEPTEMBER 10, 2024 S. Zakir
